reviewContext.userProblem: The round-12 audit found six major defects in AI capture and the 3D CAD pages. (1) A closed STL mesh and an extrusion that only share a face are reported as interfering, because the mesh volume query uses the view-dependent top-left edge rule (crates/capture/src/mesh.rs:110, :286) while the prism uses world-space ownership, so a flush fit fails --fail-on-interference with exit 1. (2) The crowded fallback of the sketch-profile segment check (packages/core/src/cad/loops.ts:406) lists every overlapping box pair: 4N^2+N exact tests for disjoint diagonal strips. (3) Capture preparation (packages/core/src/capture/scene.ts:233) searches every lower depth for each selected contour, quadratic for deep omitted ancestors and for shallow rim/hole profiles, before the point limit is charged. (4) Every side-face sketch rescans its extrusion's loop members (packages/core/src/cad/history.ts:474), M x S work. (5) The multi-target inspector re-filters and re-searches the target list for every checkbox (packages/ui-solid/src/inspector/CadSection.tsx:229, extrude-targets.ts:29-30). (6) An imported STL of two closed shells touching at an edge or face is rejected by the TS and Rust capture eligibility checks (packages/io/src/nmesh/capture-decoder.ts:120, crates/capture/src/mesh.rs:59-63) although the desktop Manifold worker accepts it, so capture drops the whole multi-body cut and reports cad.body.missing.
requiredOutcomes: function-capture-mesh-prism-touching-face (R12-1; car12-p1, car12-p7): closed-mesh volume queries use canonical edge evaluation with a symmetric band and the prism's increases_in_world tie rule; shading (facet path) is unchanged. Rust raster tests and native CLI parity give zero pairs, no hatch and exit 0 for the flush STL/extrusion contact in front and back views; a 0.01 mm overlap gives a pair and exit 1. Goldens and determinism are unchanged.

performance-sketch-profile-pair-scans (R12-2; car12-p2a, car12-p2b): a one-sided Shamos-Hoey provesDisjoint module, used only past the existing SWEEP_PAIRS_PER_BOX threshold, makes segmentTests and total work grow at most 2.5x per doubling for the diagonal-strip fixture; ordered loops are identical; the crossing and repeated-vertex controls report the same first ID as the old enumeration; the ordinary 500-feature fixture keeps segmentFallbacks === 0 and its pinned segmentTests (audit: 164,000).

performance-capture-selected-loop-ancestry-work (R12-3; car12-p3): normaliseToolLoops counts depth lookups, probes and edge work against a 32-per-vertex budget and falls back to loopForest once; deep and shallow fixtures grow at most 2.5x per doubling; scene bytes equal a full-scene oracle; the ordinary 500-feature baseline pins ancestorProbes and indexEntries (audit: 5,000 and 5,500) with zero forest fallbacks.

performance-cad-side-face-member-rescans (R12-4; car12-p4): a lazy per-tool member set behind a 4 * memberTotal scan budget makes side-face membership linear for repeated, distinct and omitted-loop queries; frames and cad.reference.missing errors are unchanged; the cap path allocates nothing; the ordinary 500-feature fixture has zero index builds.

performance-cad-inspector-target-membership (R12-5; car12-p5): selectTargets builds one validated array and set per selection change, orderExtrudeTargets uses sets with listed + stored visits, and checkbox rows use selection().has; queries double exactly from N to 2N; display order for selected, unselected and missing IDs and the single-target add behaviour are unchanged.

maintainability-capture-touching-shell-mesh-eligibility (R12-6; car12-p6a, car12-p6b, car12-p6c, car12-p7): TS and Rust eligibility and Rust picture closure keep the all-two-use fast path and add a contact path (C1-C6: balanced halfedges, exact coplanar patch cancellation with attachment check, per-shell same-sign non-zero volume, disjoint integer boxes) that admits edge, face and crossed-diagonal contact fixtures; open-triangle, unbalanced, welded-overlap, double-sided-fin and coincident-shell controls stay rejected; capture keeps the difference step on both bodies, the worker exports a 480 mm^3 plate, and the release-native cut image differs from its uncut control.
nonGoals: No change to raster.rs, interference.rs, lattice.rs, tool_view.rs, scene.rs, NCS1 layout, CLI flags, Tauri, report types or goldens.

No change to SWEEP_PAIRS_PER_BOX, the containment/depth passes of loops.ts, loop-forest.ts, cad-request.ts, the CadCaptureRequest API, the history.ts profile member index, extrude-authoring.ts, cad-edits.ts or inspector/cad-edits.test.ts.
No reordering of normalization and chargeTool in scene.ts; no edits to design docs, impl-plans/README.md, package.json or lockfiles by workers; no new dependency.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, indexed reads safe under noUncheckedIndexedAccess with no non-null assertions, Biome clean on touched files, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, packages/io must not import @nodetto/core.
artifactRoots exactly ["target", "tmp/cad3d"]; evidence under tmp/car12-r12/<planId>/; each plan uses CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/car12-<plan>; no *.test.ts or *.test.tsx left under target/ or tmp/.
Per-plan gates are focused; bun run typecheck, bun run lint, mise run verify and the release-binary parity plus MCP run happen once at integration.
Workers follow the SHA-256 pre/post hash and drift-stop rule of car12-00-overview.md; shared files (mesh.rs: p1 then p6b; scene.test.ts: p3 then p6c) are re-read fresh.

The design 26.2 timing rule applies; new performance behaviour is asserted with work counters only; at most two bun test or cargo test processes at once; never relax or delete existing assertions except the documented p1 rename.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R12-1 changes only the volume path, with canonical vertex-index-ordered edge evaluation, a symmetric band and the prism's increases_in_world tie rule; shading keeps the top-left rule.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Adjacent triangles then see one tie decision (watertight), and goldens and determinism stay untouched; rechecks reuse the existing prism recheck seam.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R12-2 uses the sweep only to prove disjointness (one-sided provesDisjoint), handing off collapsed segments and any contact to the old enumeration.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: First-error identity cannot drift, and ordinary sketches never reach the new code because SWEEP_PAIRS_PER_BOX is unchanged.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R12-3 reuses loopForest behind a 32-per-vertex work budget, with all windings positive.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Every CadLoop is counter-clockwise, so loops.ts is not edited and p3 does not wait for p2b; ordinary inputs stay on the sparse path.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R12-4 builds a lazy per-tool set behind a 4 * memberTotal scan budget instead of reusing the profile member index.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The profile index covers omitted loops and would need a per-query filter; p4 stays within history.ts.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R12-5 keeps displayedExtrudeTargets as a delegating wrapper.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: extrude-authoring.ts and its tests remain unchanged.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R12-6 admits welded contacts only on a separate contact path (C1-C6) with exact integer plane keys and disjoint integer bounding boxes, implemented independently in TS and Rust.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: It is exact and linear, identical on integers in both languages, keeps every contact it cannot prove safe rejected, and leaves the fast path and its allocation counts untouched.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: All native parity assertions for R12-1 and R12-6 move to one final plan p7 that depends on every other plan.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The release binary bundles the TypeScript core and must build once from a settled tree; p7 is the only editor of capture.test.ts.

intentionalTradeoffs: The existing Rust test cube_surface_casts_are_not_ownership_sensitive is renamed and its [0,0] point asserts the new volume result; the other four points keep their assertions.
A crowded sketch that does contain a contact or repeated vertex still pays the old quadratic enumeration on its error path.

R12-6 is narrower than Manifold: touching shells with overlapping bounding boxes, partial face contacts with differing patch boundaries, welded overlaps and double-sided fins stay display-only with cad.body.missing.
In the native contact test, no hatch is asserted as PNG equality with the --no-interference capture; the 0.01 mm overlap control requires a pair and exit 1, not a visible hatch.
R12-2 is split into p2a (module) and p2b (integration), and R12-6 into p6a, p6b and p6c, to respect plan-size limits.
supportedEdgeCases: Axis-aligned flush mesh/prism contact in front and back views; oblique ray watertightness at shared triangle edges; projected-corner rays.
Horizontal, collinear, T-touching and collapsed segments in the sweep (3,000-case differential test); crossing and repeated-vertex controls.
Deep omitted-ancestor selections, the outermost-square variant and shallow rim/hole selections; existing ancestry, grid, slotted and ray-origin fixtures.
Repeated last-member, distinct-side and omitted-loop side-face queries.
Selected, unselected and missing stored target IDs; single-target add.
Edge, face and crossed-diagonal touching shells; separated shells; off-grid raw NCS1 meshes classified as before without panic.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Oblique or curved mesh/prism contacts beyond the band guard; mesh topologies with more than two triangles per edge other than the claimed fixtures.
Boa elapsed time, desktop frame time, native peak memory, Tauri IPC, MCP delivery and desktop WebGL.
